why_this_pod_exists: H-201 xsmom_top3_6m is the closest thing the programme has to an equity edge: CI-LB +7.246 bp/day over 3,744 days, DSR 0.9469 against 0.95. The multiplicity analysis showed it fails by ONE TRIAL (DSR holds to N=28 vs 29 declared) and by 77 trading days of data at the observed effect size. 77 forward trading days is exactly what a pod produces, and it is the ONLY legitimate way to settle the cell: an independent replication adds observations without adding trials to this family. No other pod in the programme has a defined, arithmetic path to a verdict.

hypothesis.name: xsmom_top3_6m
hypothesis.statement: Ranking a broad equity universe on 6-month total return and holding the top 3 equal-weight beats a T-bill hurdle after cost

prior_evidence.fails_by_data_margin: 0.000272 of daily Sharpe = 76.7 more trading days
prior_evidence.vol_matched_warning: when scaled to SPY's volatility the excess goes NEGATIVE (-0.533), so the raw CI-LB may be volatility, not selection. The pod must report the vol-matched figure beside the raw one at every checkpoint.

universe.rule: point-in-time liquid US equities/ETFs, minimum 12-month history at entry, price >= $5, ADV >= $5M
universe.exclusions: no survivorship-based selection: a name that delists while held is marked to its last trade and counted as a loss, and its slot is NOT refilled
universe.selection_bias_control: the universe must be recorded AT ENTRY with a timestamp so the choice can be audited later

signal.formation: 6-month total return, month-end, computed ONLY from data available at that close
signal.look_ahead_ban: if a signal would change under a one-day data delay, it is void for that month and the reason is logged

execution.fill: next session's opening price, never the signal close
execution.cost_basis: ASSUMED. Equity cost is UNMEASURED in this repo (see reports/2026-11-22-data-bias-register.md). Every result must be labelled conditional on 11 bp/side until measured.
execution.capacity: position size <= 1% of the name's 20-day ADV

size_gate.reason: a verdict on 3 trades is noise; the gate is deliberate and must not be lowered to produce a result

kill_rule.trigger: at day 40 or any checkpoint after: CI-LB of mean daily excess <= 0 on FORWARD rows only
kill_rule.hard_stop: if forward n >= 40 days and the point estimate is negative, stop and record REFUTED
kill_rule.do_not_move: the bar is not to be adjusted after seeing forward data; a change requires a new hypothesis id

success_rule.trigger: at day 77 or later: CI-LB of mean daily excess > 0 on forward rows only AND vol-matched excess > 0
success_rule.then: NOT an investable verdict. It promotes the cell to CANDIDATE and the next step is a second non-overlapping universe, not capital.
success_rule.why_77: 76.7 days is the forward data margin the DSR analysis computed at the observed effect size

must_report_every_time: n days and n trades forward
raw CI-LB AND vol-matched CI-LB (both, always)
realised slippage vs the 11 bp assumption
whether any signal was voided for a data delay
reporting.must_never_report: a Sharpe or PF without its cost basis and its n

integration_note: This file is a STANDALONE spec. It is deliberately NOT merged into the shared pod manifest (audit3_tribunal reads `status != pre_registered` and barring anything else), because that manifest is owned jointly and this programme does not stage other agents' files. Merging is a one-line addition by whoever owns the manifest.
known_limitations: The backtest universe is a today's-constituents list: 0 series end early and 0 start late, which is the signature of survivorship flattering the result. The survivorship audit therefore marks H-201 UNSAFE, and the pod's point-in-time universe rule exists precisely to fix that.
The vol-matched CI-LB is negative, so a passing raw result may still be beta rather than selection.
Equity transaction cost is unmeasured; 11 bp/side is an assumption, not a measurement.
